comment: The section states that systems conform “at their boundaries,” but does not explain whether internal data may differ from national models or what transformation obligations apply at the boundary.

anchor.note: p.72 l.Lines 761-765 read as the printed page; section 3.6.1 agrees

public.text: The section states that systems conform “at their boundaries,” but does not explain whether internal data may differ from national models or what transformation obligations apply at the boundary.
public.suggestedRevision: State that systems may retain internal models, provided they expose conformant external interfaces and preserve meaning, provenance, precision, and traceability through governed mappings and transformations.
